coordinateConvention: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude; local display spans 77.34375–77.6953125°E and 18.28125–18.6328125°N.

thermal.title: THEMIS daytime thermal infrared
thermal.coverage: Bundled NASA Trek tile at zoom 9, row 203, column 732; full local planner extent.
thermal.resolution: Source mosaic nominal 100 m/pixel; this display tile approximately 81 m/pixel north–south, so display pixels do not add source detail.
thermal.date: Mosaic version: October 2018. Individual acquisition times are not supplied by this display tile.
thermal.units: Contrast-stretched grayscale display values, not calibrated degrees Celsius or Kelvin.
thermal.legend: Dark to light: displayed infrared brightness; no quantitative temperature scale is supplied.
thermal.limitations: A multi-observation orbital mosaic. Surface infrared emission is different from rover air temperature. This tile cannot supply current temperature, day/night change, thermal inertia, or heat-hazard thresholds. Different source control may leave residual offsets relative to CTX imagery.
thermal.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University; NASA Solar System Treks.

mineralogy.title: Jezero Crater Minerals
mineralogy.instrument: CRISM spectral data and CTX optical imagery
mineralogy.coverage: Jezero Crater reference figure; not registered to the interactive planner.
mineralogy.legend: Green: carbonate-bearing minerals. Red: olivine sand eroded from carbonate-containing rocks. Uncolored terrain is not proof those minerals are absent.
mineralogy.limitations: Published compositional interpretation, not a map of ongoing reactions, chemical exposure, or toxicity. Source page does not provide individual acquisition timestamps or a georeferencing transform for this figure.

thermalMineralReference.title: Infrared view of olivine-rich terrain
thermalMineralReference.coverage: Reference figure centered at approximately 18.44°N, 77.44°E; panels compare CTX, THEMIS and their composite.
thermalMineralReference.resolution: THEMIS 100 m/pixel; CTX 6 m/pixel in the published figure.
thermalMineralReference.legend: Purple/magenta in the infrared DCS view indicate an olivine-rich spectral signature. These are not temperature colors.
thermalMineralReference.limitations: Annotated comparison figure, not a registered planner layer. No individual acquisition date is given in the source description.

geology.title: Geologic map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum region
geology.authors: Vivian Z. Sun and Kathryn M. Stack
geology.coverage: 76.8–77.8°E, 17.7–18.7°N. Reference map sheet includes the legend and wider regional context.
geology.methods: Units interpreted from CTX texture, tone, morphology, setting and stratigraphy, supported by THEMIS nighttime IR, CTX/HRSC terrain and HiRISE imagery.
geology.limitations: Interpretive geological boundaries at publication scale, not engineering traversability or exact rock boundaries. The supplied map-sheet preview is not a registered raster; it is displayed separately from the planner.

units.name: Jezero crater deposits
units.description: The published map distinguishes crater-interior deposits and their stratigraphic relationships, including the delta and crater-floor materials. Use the map legend for individual unit abbreviations.

units.name: Bedrock and regional units
units.description: Regional bedrock and Nili Planum units provide context for the geological history around Jezero. Composition is not uniform across a whole mapped unit.

units.name: Aeolian and impact-related units
units.description: Wind-related and crater units occur in the mapped region. Their presence does not quantify soil bearing strength or identify every small obstacle.

geology.credit: Sun and Stack, USGS, 2020; prepared for NASA. Public-domain map.
